**Wrote the 4.2.0 entry.**

Out of 380 commits, 12 items were user-facing. One new feature, eleven fixes.

[CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3)

Highlights: webhook retries with backoff, expired tokens now `401` not `403`, paginator null-cursor crash fixed, request bodies no longer logged in full.

No breaking changes this cycle.

Next: check the auth `401` change against any docs that still say `403`.
